Three principles

// Build

Off-the-shelf components

Built from readily available parts, so the robot is easier to source, build, repair, and upgrade.

// Run

Efficiency

Automation that does more work with less waste and fewer interruptions.

// Decide

Autonomy

Onboard intelligence, so the robot can decide and adapt without constant direction.

Soft shell, hard engineering

A soft, rounded head sits on an egg-shaped body. The shell is made of a small number of clean parts, so it is simple to build and service.

  • HeadRounded cube with a front face plate and openings for sensing
  • BodyOne-piece silhouette, split into four shell sections

Everything in the head

A see-through view shows how the electronics are packed inside the head, with the ports reachable from outside.

  • ComputeRaspberry Pi 5
  • PortsGigabit Ethernet, USB 3.0, USB 2.0
  • SensingArducam IMX519, ReSpeaker mics
